svg.title: Assignment boundaries and precision
svg.desc: Twenty branches each contain twenty-five employees and are assigned ten per arm. Design effect 2.92 gives approximately 171 independent-person equivalents. Ten branches of 50 give 102, forty branches averaging 12.5 give 260 under equal-size planning assumptions. Assignment counts remain 10, 20, 40.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(98%,98%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: 500 employees; 20 independent branch assignments, ten per arm.
